title: Resolving Macromolecules by Rotary Shadowing, Negative Staining and Atomic Force Microscopy: A Comparison of Methods Applied to Identical Samples
content: We prepared three proteins by rotary shadowing (RS), negative staining (PTA), and atomic force microscopy (AFM) to determine if one method might consistently yield superior resolution. Although the structure of many proteins has been revealed at Angstrom resolution by cryo-electron microscopy, we recognize that many Investigators do not have access to cryo-EM, but do have access to the less expensive vacuum evaporators, AFM apparatus and/or negative stain reagents.
